Subject: EB alignment: mutual action plan and close-week orchestration

Hi Amira —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. We want to make the executive briefing (EB) next week as efficient as possible for your execs and to ensure the mutual action plan (MAP) reflects realistic evaluation steps. I attached a working MAP and a draft EB agenda to this thread.

Can you confirm the following by EOD Tuesday?
- Who will attend from your side (names + approx titles) for the EB?
- Any blocking requirements for security/compliance we should surface now?
- Preferred final date/time windows (we have 11/10–11/12 open for senior availability)

Proposed next steps from our side:
1) Finalize MAP milestones and owners (we’ll update the spreadsheet).
2) Share a condensed evaluation plan (success criteria + data access checklist).
3) Book a 30-min pre-brief with your CTO or product lead 48 hours before EB to align on outcomes.

Attaching: CypherBio_MAP_v1.xlsx, EB_Agenda_Draft.pdf, eval-plan-questions.docx

Thanks —
Irene
Irene Choi | Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

Irene —

Appreciate the quick follow-up and the drafts. High level answers:
- EB attendees: Myself (Head of Data & AI), Dr. Naveed Rana (CTO), Leah Park (VP Product). I will confirm titles and a final calendar invite tomorrow.
- Security: we'll need an abbreviated SOC2 artifacts list and a short note on data residency for our legal team — they might loop in an information security rep.
- Dates: 11/11 late-morning Pacific is best for our execs; 11/10 afternoon is a backup.

Regarding the MAP: I like the milestones but would prefer a tighter evaluation window — can we compress the POC phase to 3 business days instead of 5? Sam (copied) is helping us with the integration requirements.

Thanks,
Amira
